text:
Alex: Hey folks — last-minute request: I have a family thing and need someone to cover the night shift this Saturday 23:00-07:00 UTC. I can swap and take a weekday evening in return (Mon 18:00-00:00 UTC). Will trade comp time. Anyone able to pick up the full shift? @Jamie @Sophia :pray:
Jamie: I can take 23:00-03:00. Not the whole night though.
Sophia: I can do 03:00-07:00 if the team is ok with splitting. I have a morning meeting Monday so I can't take your Mon evening.
Alex: Thanks both — splitting works if @Maria or someone can cover the gap 03:00-23:00? (typo: gap 03:00-07:00) Actually need full coverage; splitting between Jamie and Sophia plus a carryover won't cover the middle 03:00-04:00.
Maria: I can stretch one hour 02:00-04:00 but only if I'm swapped out of my Tue night. Would prefer not to take extra weekdays.
oncall-bot: Reminder: shift-swap requests must be posted at least 2 hours before shift start and require explicit ack from oncall lead. Use `/oncall swap` to record the change.
Jamie: Ok — if Maria does 02:00-04:00 I can do 23:00-02:00 and Sophia 04:00-07:00. That would leave 02:00-04:00 covered by Maria.
Sophia: I can move to 04:00-07:00, yes.
Maria: Confirmed for 02:00-04:00. But I need someone to pick up my Tue night (20:00-04:00). Happy to swap with comp time.
Alex: Great — team plan then: Jamie 23:00-02:00, Maria 02:00-04:00, Sophia 04:00-07:00. I will log the swap as soon as someone from oncall lead ack + update the rota. @oncall-lead please ack. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Action required: @oncall-lead must approve swap. To finalize, run:
```
/oncall swap --from Alex --to Jamie --shift 2026-03-28T23:00Z --notes "family emergency; swap with Maria and Sophia covering segments"
```
Alex: I'll run that once approved. Thanks so much everyone. :heart: 
Jamie: No problem. I'll be online 23:00 UTC. Ping me if anything pops.
Sophia: I'll set a quick handoff note in the rota and leave my pager instructions.
Maria: Also posted a short note in the team calendar about needing Tue night cover — anyone who wants that comp time can DM me.
Alex: Last ask — please add short handoff lines in the rota: open sessions, noisy jobs to watch, and the KV cache warm-up step. Quick snippet to paste:
```
Handoff: prefix-cache warm-up (run `curl https://internal/prime-cache -d "prefix=foo"`), watch for spike in 10-11 token latency, restart model-proxy if tail lat >1s (`systemctl restart model-proxy`).
```
Jamie: Got it.
Sophia: Got it.
Maria: Got it.
oncall-bot: Swap request queued — pending approval."
